channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: 🔒 NASA tech for healthy skin: Delavie Sciences emerged from deep research, and several pivots
item.description: Kyle Landry’s path to becoming the co-founder and president of skincare company Delavie Sciences was a windy one.

item.title: 🔒 Space mission: Dozens of Central Mass. firms work with NASA, including WPI, where researchers follow in Goddard’s footsteps
item.description: Today at WPI, Cote and her colleagues are continuing Goddard’s legacy of innovation through research that advances our presence in space.

item.title: 🔒 Goddard’s legacy: The past, present, and future of Central Mass. innovation
item.description: Central Massachusetts’ history of innovation did not begin with Goddard, nor did it end with his death in 1945. Spanning from the Industrial Revolution to today, the region’s innovators left their mark across industries.

item.title: Panera Bread to close Franklin facility, lay off 92 employees
item.description: Panera’s facility at 290 Beaver St. is set to close its doors on March 27.

item.title: Marlborough hospital enters Code Black, relocates 70+ patients after valve break
item.description: All inpatients at UMass Memorial Medical Center’s Marlborough Campus were transported to neighboring hospitals on Sunday evening.

item.title: 🔒 Engineering firm expands in Worcester with move to Mercantile Center
item.description: The move to the 10th floor of the Mercantile Center office tower will give the firm the chance to expand to up to 40 employees.

item.title: 🔒 Former Saint Vincent CEO named COO of Rhode Island hospital
item.description: Carolyn Jackson, the former leader of Saint Vincent Hospital in Worcester, has moved onto a new C-suite role at a Rhode Island facility.

item.title: GreenTech Park redevelopment to use local, diverse labor; abide by enhanced energy codes
item.description: The Worcester Business Development Corp., the City, and representatives of organized labor have signed a community benefit agreement for the 51-acre development.

item.title: 🔒 Millis private school constructing 18K-sq.-ft. building for high school expansion
item.description: The new building is expected to open for the 2026-27 school year.

item.title: Former Westborough cinema to become Hindu worship site, following $5.1M sale
item.description: The site was purchased by a Hindu denomination headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, which has more than 5,000 centers of worship across the globe.
